info.name: Refine Feature
info.desc: Resume editing and refinement functionality with form-based input fields. Supports editing personal information, skills, work experience, and education. Uses real-time data synchronization with backend API and persistent template selection via localStorage.
info.tech: React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Form Management, API Integration, i18n, localStorage
